raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions builds txn_date from ingest_ts, which is always 02:00 on the day after the transaction, so every POSTED row (4600) lands one day late. The DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor defines txn_date as the date of txn_ts, so txn_date should come from txn_ts. The gold daily tables inherit the shifted dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
